skills.name: ask-question
skills.description: Answers questions using only repository READMEs and configured documentation folders. Prefers the filesystem MCP server when available. Use when the user asks about project processes, local setup, assumptions, or existing documentation.

skills.name: decision-record
skills.description: Helps create and update project decision records in the configured decisions directory. Use when the user needs to record a project decision, options considered, or the chosen solution.

skills.name: dont-over-help
skills.description: Matches the amount of help to what the user asked for. Avoids extra rewrites, explanations, or summaries. Use as a core dependency for communication skills, or whenever the agent must stay within the requested scope.

skills.name: dyslexia-friendly-formatting
skills.description: Formats information so it is easier to scan and process using short sections, headings, bullets, numbered steps, and clear emphasis. Requires the dont-over-help skill. Use when the user asks for dyslexia-friendly layout or easier scanning.

skills.name: explain-simply
skills.description: Breaks down complex subjects, instructions, or terminology into simple explanations, key points, and examples. Requires the dont-over-help skill. Use when the user asks for a plain-language explanation of a complex topic.

skills.name: memory-settings
skills.description: Checks for and creates the shared project memory configuration at .memory/settings.yml. Use when another skill needs this file, or when the user asks to set up memory settings.

skills.name: organise-messy-thoughts
skills.description: Turns rough notes, fragmented ideas, or unstructured thoughts into a clear logical structure. Requires the dont-over-help skill. Use when the user asks to organise notes, structure ideas, or clean up messy thinking.

skills.name: preserve-user-voice
skills.description: Improves someone's writing without making it sound unnaturally formal, academic, or unlike the original writer. Requires the dont-over-help skill. Use when the user wants edits that keep their natural voice and tone.

skills.name: simplify-text
skills.description: Rewrites dense or complex text in clear plain English while preserving the original meaning. Requires the dont-over-help skill. Use when the user asks to simplify wording, reduce complexity, or make text easier to read.

skills.name: writing-support
skills.description: Helps users write emails, messages, documents, and other content by improving clarity, spelling, grammar, and flow without being critical. Requires the dont-over-help skill. Use when the user asks for writing help or gentle corrections.
